title: Support looks up Grace Okafor then updates her phone
userProblem: Grace Okafor at Cedar Health has a new phone number. First find her contact record, then update her phone to +44 20 7946 0088.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent looks up con_005 (Grace Okafor), updates her phone to +44 20 7946 0088, and confirms the change.

assertions.description: Agent must look the contact up first.
Agent must update the contact after lookup.
Update targets the right contact and phone field.
DB reflects the updated phone number.
Trace must follow the multi-step shape: search then update.

rationale: Core multi-step scenario: lookup then update, verifying both steps execute in order.
